title: River House Weekend Plan
lead: A shared plan with room to change it. The only fixed appointment is lunch with Nana on Saturday.
label: one shared list · fewer messages
intro: A fictional family plan for two adults and two children. Keep food, travel and quiet time visible; check items as they are packed rather than assuming they are done.
sections: Rain jackets, refillable bottles, medication, chargers and one book each. Keep medication with the adult responsible for it.
Bring Friday supper. Buy breakfast ingredients locally. Confirm dietary needs before Saturday lunch; the sample plan does not assume medical requirements.
Use the shared notice space for the new meeting time. Agree on one pickup point before anyone leaves the house.
closing: Fictional household · Adapt the plan to your family and access needs.
prompt: Use Dazzler to create a fictional family document for its real reader task: A shared plan with room to change it. The only fixed appointment is lunch with Nana on Saturday. Preserve the supplied numbers and qualifications. Develop a new pack plan leave composition, with a packing-first household sheet with a compact weekend itinerary and an open change notice. Use Work Sans in HTML and verified Arial for native Word. Make print and mobile reading clear; use purposeful #173D8F color against #ADE0FF. Do not copy the earlier gallery layout.
colorDirection: Bright sky-blue itinerary, sunny packing field and coral day markers on white.
